## Software

Muñoz, J.F., Pavía, J.M., & Álvarez-Verdejo, E. (2024). *giniVarCI: Gini Indices, Variances and Confidence Intervals for Finite and Infinite Populations*. R package version 0.0.1-3. <https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.giniVarCI>. See [the package page](software.qmd).

## Working papers

1. *The problem of missing data in strategic management research: critical issues, understanding and methodological insights.* F. Vendrell-Herrero, J.F. Muñoz, E. Gomes and D.W. Lehman.
2. *The GiniUs library for the estimation of the Gini index.* J.F. Muñoz, J.M. Pavía and E. Álvarez-Verdejo. To be submitted to the *Journal of Statistical Software*.
3. *How to avoid common mistakes in water studies with missing data?* J.F. Muñoz, E. Álvarez-Verdejo, C. Tortajada and M.D. Sarwar. To be submitted to *Water Research*.
